context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the write-yard-docs instructions from the published Ruby Core Skills plugin.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Use this skill when documenting Ruby classes and public methods with YARD.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: All YARD text must be in English unless user explicitly requests otherwise.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Task lists MUST include explicit YARD sub-tasks after implementation.

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Add Method-Level Docs:** For every public method, add `@param` (and `@option` for hash arguments), `@return`, and `@raise` tags. For `.call` methods or complex returns, the `@return` tag MUST specify the exact structure.

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Verify Completeness:** Run `yard stats --list-undoc` and `yard doc` to ensure no public surfaces are missing documentation.

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Task-list handoff:** When producing or reviewing tasks, add explicit YARD sub-tasks after implementation for every new or changed public Ruby API. If the output is only a documentation artifact (not a task list), state that future task lists must include those YARD sub-tasks.
